config.name: temporal_skillcorner_v1
config.description: Temporal context (session 3, pre-registered in docs/RESEARCH.md before running). Primary hypotheses: H-T1 time-on-ball/event timing improves the decision-time event baseline (Adt -> Adt_tob); H-T2 1.0 s movement history improves decision-time spatial context beyond static positions + time-on-ball (Bdt_tob -> Bdt_tt); H-T3 the decision-time spatial gain survives the stronger temporal event baseline (Adt_tob -> Bdt_tob). 0.5 s / 2.0 s lookbacks and Bdt_ttonly are sensitivity analyses. Same rules v2, LOMO, a-priori hyperparameters and possession-clustered paired bootstrap as pass_outcome_v3. Revised before any valid run after the independent review (2026-11-14): time-on-ball is censored (NaN) when an unobserved ball ends the run; a header/cross control comparison is added; strata are restart vs open play.

Adt_logreg.description: decision-time event context only (no release features), LR

Bdt_logreg.description: decision-time event + spatial context (no release features), LR

Adt_te_logreg.description: decision-time events + time since previous event, LR

Adt_tob_logreg.description: decision-time events + event timing + tracking time-on-ball, LR

Bdt_tob_logreg.description: decision-time spatial + event timing + time-on-ball, LR

Bdt_tt_logreg.description: decision-time spatial + timing + time-on-ball + 1.0 s movement history, LR

Bdt_tt05_logreg.description: as Bdt_tt with a 0.5 s lookback (sensitivity), LR

Bdt_tt20_logreg.description: as Bdt_tt with a 2.0 s lookback (sensitivity), LR

Bdt_ttonly_logreg.description: decision-time spatial + 1.0 s movement history only (no timing/time-on-ball), LR

Adt_tob_gbm.description: decision-time events + event timing + tracking time-on-ball, GBM

Bdt_tob_gbm.description: decision-time spatial + event timing + time-on-ball, GBM

Bdt_tt_gbm.description: decision-time spatial + timing + time-on-ball + 1.0 s movement history, GBM
